en: A monochrome image showing a bust of a bearded man on a tall stone pedestal inscribed with the name "ALBERT." The monument is set in a lush, tree‑filled park or garden, surrounded by dense shrubs. In the foreground there is a decorative metal fence with stout posts linked by chains. Along the left edge of the image there are hand‑written numbers or notes, typical of early photographic postcard negatives.
